set.body:
Scope: build.sbt/provider overrides, dependency preparation, CI, README, vision.md, module-relations and affected ADRs across changed libraries.

Deliverable: Admit one immutable provider revision set, propagate explicit local overrides, update bounded platform checks and direct-composition quickstarts, and retire superseded guidance with links.

Acceptance:
- Ordinary builds resolve no floating branches, sibling paths or duplicate provider identities; local overrides propagate intentionally.
- Build aggregates/aliases and bounded JVM/JS CI cover the resulting modules; platform-specific gates remain separate.
- Examples demonstrate direct provider types and optional ScalaFIM integration; architectural docs and deletion ledger match source.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
